name: Unidentified world (Voegliss)
description: At one point during the reign of the Galactic Empire, the Imperial scientist Devlor Samt and his team surveyed a supposedly uninhabited world. There, the team came under a ferocious attack by two members of a sentient species that was not native to the world.
